author: ethdreamer
content:
Ran the minimal tests from that exact run (`b73c6956`). **7,673 of 8,657 cases pass; not fully green.** Ignored the coverage-step failure as requested.

Fixed and pushed to `sigp/lighthouse:pq-devnet-1` at `5325f038ba`: legacy-deposit key/VRF derivation used SHA instead of Keccak, malformed aggregate bitfields could be ignored as duplicates, and unknown proposer indices were ignored instead of rejected. Also added PQ reference-test adapters.

Remaining: 246 partial-column bitmap SSZ root failures (`BitList` vs `ProgressiveBitList`); 31 cases involving unsupported requests; 15 pre-PQ upgrade load failures from our PQ-only validator/builder layout; 692 harness limitations/skips. All 167 epoch, 83 sanity, 82 fork-choice, 409 implemented-operation and 117 supported-networking cases pass.

Full breakdown and reproduction commands:
https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/blob/5325f038bae7e537f8f528fc25bd2d0093c1a8d4/testing/ef_tests/PQ_REFERENCE_RESULTS.md
